review_binding.required: REVIEW_PR=4500 and REVIEW_HEAD_SHA=<final exact head containing this PR binding>

owned: explicit promotion and rollback transaction state machine
exact PID/starttime termination, governed candidate launch, and captured incumbent relaunch
independent launch-return boundaries and strictly increasing loop markers
parent-owned spawned-child containment with fail-closed unknown-child evidence
projection, worker/queue/lease, provider, config, root, commit, and tree rollback proof
atomic durable promoted, rolled_back, aborted, and rollback_failed evidence
safe-by-default discover-only wrapper with explicit --promote activation
mock-only failure injection and PID-reuse termination tests

provider, account, quota-group, or reviewer policy
